The Will Eisner Comic Industry Awards

The Will Eisner Comic Industry Awards are given out each year at San Diego Comic-Con. The awards are given for creative achievement in the American comic book industry. They also give out an award each year for best academic or scholarly work, many of which we have available in the Libraries in either print or digital format. You can see a full list of previous nominees in this category on Wikipedia.
